title: questlog batons.json
description: OPTIONAL per-roadmap handoff record. A baton is a compact briefing one AI session banks for the next (done / in-flight / next / warnings), so a thread survives a session boundary or a compaction. Lives at <projectRoot>/.questlog/batons.json alongside roadmap.json. Absent file = no batons yet (normal). Present file is validated strictly. schemaVersion stays 1 (back-compatible: old dirs load fine). Kept a SEPARATE file so roadmap.json's strict schema is untouched.

ts.description: REQUIRED. When the baton was banked.

kind.description: OPTIONAL (absent === "handoff", so every baton written before kinds existed still validates). "handoff" joins the session-to-session chain that baton_read/baton_peek walk. "brief" is a FEATURE BRIEF addressed to one session via toSessionId: it is deliberately EXCLUDED from that chain, so an addressed brief never shadows the real handoff baton nor flips its author to derived-superseded.

fromSessionId.description: REQUIRED. The session that banked this baton (free-form session id, NOT the lowercase entity-id regex).

toSessionId.description: REQUIRED. For a handoff: the session that picked it up (set by baton_read pickUp:true), or null while open. For a brief: the session the brief is ADDRESSED to, set at creation.

done.description: REQUIRED array of strings — what got finished.

inFlight.description: REQUIRED array of strings — half-done work.

next.description: REQUIRED array of strings — concrete next steps.

warnings.description: REQUIRED array of strings — gotchas for the next session.

docPath.description: REQUIRED. Path to a longer write-up, or null.

status.description: REQUIRED. "open" = waiting to be picked up (banked work); "picked_up" = a later session claimed it (the banking session is then derived-superseded).
